label: def:molecular-assembly-projector
title: Molecular assembly projector $e_{\lambda,\mu}$
html:
Definition. Molecular assembly projector e_{\lambda,\mu}

Definition. Let \lambda be a strand-partition of N and \mu \vdash N a Wedderburn block of H_N(q). The assembly projector e_{\lambda,\mu} \in H_N(q) is the canonical idempotent projecting the composite's module onto the irreducible block \mu.

It is the q-Young symmetriser for the pair (\lambda,\mu). The distinguished case \mu = (N)—projection onto the one-row symmetric block—is delocalisation.

For benzene, e_{(2,2,2),(6)} projects the six \pi-electrons onto the symmetric block. This represents the categorical content of the aromatic ring, realised geometrically as its T(2,6) threading link.
